newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Hewlett is up 1-7/8.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Hewlett is up 1-7/8.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard rose sharply in after-hours trading on Tuesday, up 1-7/8 to 51-3/8, after releasing its quarterly financial results.
"Hewlett's really the big news," one trader said. "It's the only one we're really seeing anything happening on."
After regular trading hours ended, Hewlett-Packard released first quarter results showing net income per share of $0.87, up from $0.75 per share for the same period a year ago.
Hewlett-Packard shares had declined to 49-1/2 during regular trading hours Tuesday, after opening at 50-1/2.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one volume was 45,100, compared to 226,200 on Friday. Session two volume was 2,238,707, while on Friday it was 11,171,394.
